title: The Little Tuk
summary: Little Tuk had to learn his geography lesson for school the next morning, but he had to rock his baby sister's cradle and run errands for his old mother until late at night....
full_text:
Out in the wide, tranquil meadows where wildflowers bent gracefully before the seaside breeze, there lived Little Tuk had to learn his geography lesson for school the next morning, but he had to rock his baby sister's cradle and run errands for his old mother until late at night..... While the hurried world rushed past with noisy ambitions and proud words, the quiet creatures of the hearth and garden listened to the gentle music of life, noticing the delicate details that noisy vanity never perceives.

As the twilight settled and shadows lengthened across the floorboards, the deeper meaning of the journey became clear. Through the changing seasons of frost, rain, and golden summer light, the heart learned to endure every trial with gentle patience. In moments of solitude and quiet longing, the soul whispered its sincere hopes to the stars, discovering that true worth does not depend on outward glitter or the praise of the crowd.

At last, when the trial reached its appointed close, the light of genuine virtue shone with irresistible radiance. When the moment of transformation arrived, truth dissolved the illusions of pride and vanity.  The cold winds melted away into a dawn of peace, leaving behind a fragrant memory that touched every heart with wonder, proving that faithful performance of family duties brings wisdom and blessings in the school of life.
moral: Faithful performance of family duties brings wisdom and blessings in the school of life.
